response.answer: Randomized controlled trials show vouchers can boost fruit affordability and consumption in Nigeria and Vietnam. Social science trends in nutrition policies highlight the importance of urban/peri-urban settings for effective interventions. Cluster trial methodologies are effective for measuring changes in food voucher consumption behavior.
